news.title: Legora Raised a $550 Million Series E at an $8.8 Billion Valuation, Led by Atreides Management
Legora raises US$550 million from Series E fundraise
Legora raises $550 million in a Series E funding round to accelerate its growth, valuing the company at $8.8 billion
